Located just south of our Laguna Niguel facility, the drive is easy and quick via the I-5 or Camino Capistrano.

Cats Luv Us Boarding Hotel has been serving San Juan Capistrano and the surrounding South Orange County communities since 1993. Our cat-exclusive facility at 27601 Forbes Rd in Laguna Niguel is just a short drive from San Juan Capistrano, making it convenient for drop-offs and pick-ups. Whether you need overnight boarding, professional grooming, daytime daycare, or medication administration, our trained cat care specialists are here to give your feline companion the love and attention they deserve.
